title: The Wardrobe of the reservoir
author: Ulyana Nakamura
blurb: Wendell Marchetti, a translator losing a childhood language one borrowed word at a time, has spent ten years practicing the art of almost saying it. Then a childhood home goes up for auction — and he is pulled straight into the middle of it. Now he must translate the untranslatable sentence and live with it, and time is already running out.
style: atmospheric and lyrical, with strong sensory detail
